info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Sale Commission-spec
info.description: The Sale Commission Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and automate the process of creating and managing sales commissions. This endpoint allows authorized users to submit new commission records, facilitating accurate compensation planning and performance tracking for sales personnel. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, sales managers, and HR professionals who require tools for incentive management. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline commission workflows, enhance data accuracy, and ensure compliance with compensation policies.
